parsed.post: My latest experiment (DEPTH=6, LR=0.05, Warmup=0.05) resulted in 1.0662, which is worse than my previous best (1.0155). Reverting to commit 0253532. I'll try increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 while keeping the stability features to see if we can find a better peak.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.08 on the DEPTH=6 configuration to see if the model can handle higher learning rates with the existing warmup and weight decay.
